tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a seminar on finding a job after graduation. You thought the seminar was very valuable and want to follow up with the presenter, Ms. Johnson, to give some feedback and ask for additional resources. Write an email to Ms. Johnson.
bullets: Express your gratitude for Ms. Johnson giving the seminar.
Mention which topics you found most interesting.
Ask about additional resources to help you find a job after graduation.
tasks.subject: Feedback on your seminar and a request
